name: Kas Glute Bridge
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the long side of a bench. Roll a padded barbell over your legs until it is above your hips.
Put your feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart. Raise your hips until your upper back rests on the bench, with your shins vertical at the top.
Lower your hips only a short distance, until your hips are a few inches below the top position. Keep your ribs down and your chin tucked.
Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to raise your hips back to the top. Pause, and repeat.
